title: Remove test-options.md's reference to tool/device_e2e/night_runner.py — the file does not exist in the repo

evidence.quote:
- `night_runner.py` — continuous soak loop; self-cleans each iteration
    (deletes its test account/data/token).

why: test-options.md lists night_runner.py as an existing 'piece' of the on-device E2E harness alongside driver.py, journey_01_signup_profile.py and README.md — all three of which do exist. `find . -iname 'night_runner*'` across the whole repo returns nothing. The rest of this doc (layer table, CI job list, ~10,000-test count, test/e2e|sync|overflow paths) was verified accurate, so this single fabricated-sounding entry stands out and would send someone looking for a soak-test script that was never committed (or was planned and never built).
recommendation: Either remove the night_runner.py bullet or, if it's planned work, reword it as 'planned: a continuous soak loop is not yet built' to match the doc's own honest framing elsewhere ('one journey proven; full per-screen coverage builds out journey-by-journey').
acceptance_criteria: test-options.md only lists tool/device_e2e/ files that exist, or explicitly marks planned-but-unbuilt ones as such
